prompt: Diels-Alder: cyclopentadiene + maleic anhydride, heat. Draw the endo cycloadduct.

answers.label: endo-norbornene dicarboxylic anhydride (classic DA textbook result)

explanation: Cyclopentadiene (locked s-cis) + maleic anhydride is the quintessential Diels-Alder demo. The endo product is kinetically preferred (secondary orbital overlap between diene π orbitals and the anhydride C=O π orbitals in the TS).
